facts.value: Rail clamp at SENSE behind R_LIMIT 10 kOhm: while the TMUX7412F still passes between VDD and VDD + VT, this diode alone lets SENSE exceed V+ by min(VT, VF), and neither has a maximum at this current (VT 0.7 V typical at 25 C; BAV199 VF maximum only at >= 1 mA). Phase 25 adds D_BOOT (BAT54S,215 across the follower), which holds SENSE <= V+ + 0.27 V at 25 C; the input current (<= about 70 uA) is far below the 10 mA row.
facts.conditions: OPA4197 SBOS737C 6.1 lists the voltage and current rows separately with no current-limited exception.
